articleTitle: Shirataki vs. Cauliflower Rice for Bulking Fried Rice
imageHeadline: Shirataki vs. Cauliflower Rice: Which Bulks Better?
imageSubtext: Same volume, different fiber—here's how to choose for your fried rice.
pinTitle: Shirataki vs. Cauliflower Rice for Bulking Fried Rice: How to Choose
pinDescription: Both shirataki and cauliflower rice add serious volume to fried rice for minimal calories, but they work differently. Shirataki's soluble fiber helps you stay fuller longer, while cauliflower crisps up and adds vegetables to your plate. Learn which filler fits your goals and how to prep each one for the best texture.

items.label: Shirataki
items.sublabel: Soluble fiber for satiety, chewy texture

items.label: Cauliflower Rice
items.sublabel: Crisps in the pan, adds vegetable serving
